name: NEA Nepal Daily Operational Report (transd)
fetcher: httpx, then headed Chrome via Playwright (F5 bot protection)
notes: 1-page text PDF: daily energy MWh (11 values) + peak MW table (time + 9 values). No per-plant or reservoir data.

name: NEA homepage 'Energy Details' widget (daily snapshot)
cadence: every 3h (row kept only when numbers change)
notes: Undated; most likely previous day. Fields: NEA/subsidiary/IPP gen, import, export, interruption, total & national energy demand (MWh), total & national peak (MW). Balance holds: sources = total demand; total - export = national. Only public daily NEA figures after NDOR stopped (Jan 2025). ldc.nea.org.np checked 2026-10-25: template placeholder, no data.

name: Legacy NEA LDC NDOR PDFs via Wayback Machine
history: unknown, originals ~2079 BS onwards (now 404 on nea.org.np)
notes: Checked 2026-10-25: Wayback CDX has no NDOR PDFs for transd or legacy ldc paths. Not implemented.

notes: Some titles end in 'rev1'. Tables parsed in Phase 2. NMOR 2080_02..09 detail pages link to 404 PDFs (uploads/shares/Annual%20Report/) — NEA-side broken links. Listing ignores ?page=.

name: NEA Yearly Operational Summary
fetcher: httpx, then headed Chrome via Playwright (F5 bot protection)

fetcher: httpx, then headed Chrome via Playwright (F5 bot protection)

name: Open-Meteo Historical Weather (ERA5)
notes: Free, no key, non-commercial. CC BY 4.0.

name: Open-Meteo Flood API (GloFAS river discharge)
notes: ~5 km GloFAS grid. basin=true points (Koshi, Narayani/Gandaki, Karnali) drain most Nepal hydro and form gold discharge_index; checked 2026-10-25 by snapping to the max-flow cell. Per-plant points are approximate: Marsyangdi/Trishuli plausible, others need_user_verification (snapping jumped to other rivers).

name: DHM River Watch (realtime gauge levels)
history: latest reading only; history accumulates from our snapshots
notes: Inline 'var coordinates = [...]' JSON, ~309 gauges, water level (m) not discharge. DOWN since 2026-10-25 (site offline, reportedly PHP vulnerability). Ingester ready; re-run `nea ingest dhm` when back.

name: DHM historical data (email request)
notes: Email sent 2026-10-25 (docs/outreach/dhm-data-request.md); awaiting reply. Loader added when data arrives.

name: World Bank yearly indicators, Nepal (GDP, population)
notes: GDP constant 2015 US$ + population: yearly demand-growth drivers. Full refresh each run (WB revises past years).

name: Grid-India NLDC daily PSP report (transnational exchange)
notes: Post-2025 proxy for Nepal import/export when NDOR missing. 2026-10-25: report.grid-india.in no longer resolves; grid-india.in resets connections from this laptop. User to check in browser.

name: India Ministry of Commerce TradeStat, HS 27160000 Electrical Energy (Nepal row)
fetcher: httpx, per-worker session (one-time CSRF token per POST), 6 parallel
notes: India export to Nepal = Nepal import (direction nepal_import); India import = nepal_export. MWh (TKW) + INR crore. Customs booking is lumpy (all-zero months, e.g. Feb 2018) - FY-to-date total stored too. vs NEA annual import: 2021 exact, most years within 5-19%, 2023 +32%. Raw: one JSON per query in data/raw/india_trade/ (result table only, one record per country, numbers as numbers).

name: CERC monthly short-term market report (Excel), cross-border trade at IEX
notes: Nepal row of every 'CROSS BORDER TRADE THROUGH <market>' table: DAM / RTM. purchase = Nepal import, sale = Nepal export (MU = GWh) + weighted price INR/kWh. Short-term exchange trade only (not long-term/bilateral).
